title: Multibeat control remains stable after the first accepted beat

source.statement: Control signals for a burst that is in progress must remain constant and identify the same message as the first beat.

trigger_event.description: the first beat of a multibeat message is accepted

response_event.description: a later beat of the same burst is presented

preconditions: the channel carries a multibeat message

required_observations.description: selected A/C/D channel changed control during an active burst
